_comment: Canonical Shared Studio feature modules (Phase I). Each of these has exactly ONE source implementation, in @valori/studio (Valori-Kernel/ui/studio/src). Host applications (Valori-Kernel/ui/src, valori-ui/ui/src) may wrap or extend them via a differently-named file, but must never contain a second source file with one of these exact filenames. Only feature-level modules with a proven history of accidental duplication are listed here — not generic UI-kit atoms (button.tsx, tabs.tsx, ...) and not every file that happens to live in ui/studio/src. See docs/architecture/shared-studio.md.
_hooksExcludedDeliberately: useHealth/useCluster/useCollections/useGraph/useProof/useSearch/useEmbeddingConfig/useLLMConfig were evaluated for this list and left out on purpose (Phase I). Unlike the view/tab components above, host repos legitimately keep their own copies of several of these hooks today, consumed directly by genuinely host-specific composite pages (e.g. Desktop Cloud's ProjectWorkspace, Sidebar, /search, /audit, Local's /proof) that were deliberately never migrated into Studio (see the Phase G Project Overview decision) — not by an accidental duplicate view. A filename-only check can't tell that apart from a real accidental duplicate without import-graph analysis, which this guard intentionally does not do. Whether those host pages should eventually import these hooks from @valori/studio instead of keeping local copies is a real open question, but it's a deliberate migration decision for a future phase, not something this guard should silently enforce or silently allowlist around.
